prompt.ja: 高齢者を含む既存ユーザー向け。メール・パスワード認証を維持し、モバイルで片手操作。日本語・英語対応。キーボード操作、パスワード管理ツール、復旧導線を必須とする。
prompt.en: Keep email/password for existing users including older adults. Support one-handed mobile use, Japanese/English, keyboard and password managers, with recovery.

expectedBehavior: メール限定案は認証制約に不適合と明示
ラベル・入力補助・復旧・言語拡張を具体化
品質/実現可能性/価値を別軸で提示

rubric.diversity: Distinct interaction/hierarchy/assumptions, not just color changes
rubric.requirementFit: All hard constraints honored or explicitly hypothetical
rubric.practicality: Coherent flows, states, labels and recovery
rubric.explorationEfficiency: Useful candidates relative to declared budget; no invented cost

boundary: The mechanical fixture is authored, not an agent response to the prompt. Passing it does not establish proposal quality.
